items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Reminds me of a story of Bob Rosengarden the drummer told me... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah I’m glad you didn’t learn that a few years ago.

ctx.x: A good sound crew is huge.

Reminds me of a story of Bob Rosengarden the drummer told me working for the first time with a bass player and he’s looking at the bass player and he’s going like this and the bass player says, “You want me to play louder?” And he goes, “No, play better.” You guys could use that.
Yeah I’m glad you didn’t learn that a few years ago.
